# OpenTelemetry lab telemetry

Schema URL: `https://nlamirault.github.io/opentelemetry-lab/schemas/1.0.0`

Depends on: `https://opentelemetry.io/schemas/1.43.0`

## Attributes

### `lab.app.language`

Language the lab application is written in.

- Type: enum
- Stability: development

`telemetry.sdk.language` names the SDK runtime, so it cannot tell a
JavaScript app from a TypeScript one (both are `nodejs`), and it has no
value for Zig. This attribute names the language of the lab app itself.

| Value | Stability | Description |
| ----- | --------- | ----------- |
| `go` | development | Go application (`apps/otel-go`). |
| `java` | development | Java application (`apps/otel-java`). |
| `javascript` | development | JavaScript application on Node.js (`apps/otel-js`). |
| `typescript` | development | TypeScript application on Node.js (`apps/otel-ts`). |
| `python` | development | Python application (`apps/otel-python`). |
| `rust` | development | Rust application (`apps/otel-rust`). |
| `swift` | development | Swift application (`apps/otel-swift`). |
| `zig` | development | Zig application (`apps/otel-zig`). |
| `react` | development | React application in the browser (`apps/otel-react`). |

## Metrics

### `lab.build.info`

Build information of the lab application. The value is always 1.

- Instrument: gauge
- Unit: none
- Stability: development

Follows the Prometheus `_info` idiom: a gauge whose value is 1 and whose
attributes carry the build information. It is unitless, so the
Prometheus translation stores it as `lab_build_info` with no unit or
`_total` suffix.

| Attribute | Type | Requirement level |
| --------- | ---- | ----------------- |
| `lab.app.language` | enum | required |
| `service.name` | string | required |
| `service.version` | string | required |
| `telemetry.sdk.language` | enum | recommended |

### `opentelemetry.lab.build.info`

Build information of the lab application.

- Instrument: counter
- Unit: none
- Stability: development
- Deprecated (uncategorized): Replaced by the `lab.build.info` gauge. The instrument changed from counter to gauge, so this is not a rename.

| Attribute | Type | Requirement level |
| --------- | ---- | ----------------- |
| `service.name` | string | required |
| `service.version` | string | required |
| `telemetry.sdk.language` | enum | required |
